about.title: About Edarcon
about.subtitle: Dammam-based. HSE-led. Vision 2030 aligned.
about.body: Edarcon Contracting Company is a Dammam-based industrial and civil contractor with a proven track record across the Eastern Province. We operate with an HSE-led mobilization culture, a directly employed workforce, and the ability to mobilize rapidly — staged and ready in the Eastern Province. Our operations are fully aligned with Vision 2030 through Saudization and local content commitments.

hse.title: HSE-Led Culture
hse.desc: Safety is embedded in every mobilization plan, method statement and toolbox talk.

workforce.title: Own Workforce
workforce.desc: Directly employed trades — welders, riggers, electricians — no sub-contracting of labour.

rapid.title: Rapid Mobilization
rapid.desc: Crews and plant staged in the Eastern Province, ready to deploy within days of award.

vision.title: Vision 2030 Aligned
vision.desc: Committed to Saudization targets and local content across all contracts.

process.title: How We Work
process.step1Desc: We review drawings, visit site and agree a detailed scope with the client.
process.step2Desc: Crews, plant and temporary facilities are deployed within days of confirmed award.
process.step3Desc: Work is executed to method statements with daily progress reporting to the client.
process.step4Desc: Site is cleared, inspected and formally handed over with full documentation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before engaging Edarcon.

items.q: Which clients have approved Edarcon as a vendor?
items.a: Edarcon is an approved vendor to Saudi Aramco, Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), SABIC, and Ma'aden.

items.q: Do you supply equipment with operators?
items.a: Yes. All equipment can be supplied with or without certified operators depending on your project requirements.

items.q: Can we engage Edarcon for a single service rather than a full package?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer individual service lines as well as fully integrated project support packages.

items.q: How quickly can Edarcon mobilize to site?
items.a: We can mobilize within days of a confirmed award. Our crews and plant are staged in the Eastern Province for rapid deployment.
Our head office is located at Building No 4315, Office No 5-2, King Saud Street, District Al Jalawiyah, Dammam-32246, KSA.

qualityHse.title: Quality & HSE
qualityHse.subtitle: Quality, safety and environmental management across all EDARCON operations.

hero.title: Quality, Safety & Responsibility in Every Operation
hero.description: At EDARCON, quality and safety are essential parts of how we approach industrial services, engineering support and project execution. We are committed to maintaining responsible working practices, supporting safe operations and delivering services with a focus on quality and reliability.

commitment.title: Committed to Quality at Every Stage
commitment.description:
EDARCON aims to maintain a consistent focus on quality throughout its operations. From understanding client requirements and planning activities to service execution and final delivery, we recognize the importance of responsible processes, technical competence and attention to detail.

Our approach emphasizes meeting agreed project requirements, maintaining effective communication and continually improving the way we deliver our services.

qualityFocus.title: Quality Focus
qualityFocus.desc: Attention to agreed requirements and service standards.

continuousImprovement.title: Continuous Improvement
continuousImprovement.desc: A focus on improving operational practices and performance.

certifications.title: ISO Certifications
certifications.subtitle: EDARCON's company profile references the following international management system certifications. These standards provide a framework for quality management, environmental responsibility and occupational health and safety.
certifications.verificationNote: Certificate thumbnails are displayed from scans provided by EDARCON. Certificate numbers, validity dates and the certification body remain pending document review. These standards are not presented as proof of current certification until those details have been checked.

iso9001.name: Quality Management
iso9001.desc: Quality management systems and a consistent focus on meeting customer and applicable requirements.

iso14001.name: Environmental Management
iso14001.desc: Environmental management and responsible consideration of environmental impacts.

iso45001.name: Occupational Health & Safety
iso45001.desc: Occupational health and safety management and the prevention of work-related injury and ill health.

safety.title: Safety Is Part of Every Job
safety.description:
Industrial environments require careful planning, awareness and responsible execution. EDARCON recognizes the importance of protecting its workforce, clients, contractors and surrounding environment.

We aim to promote safe working practices through appropriate personal protective equipment, awareness of site requirements, responsible work execution and attention to potential operational risks.
safety.note: Presented as areas of commitment, not as claims that specific formal procedures or training programs exist unless EDARCON confirms them.

mobile-crane-25t.name: Mobile Crane 25T
mobile-crane-25t.shortDescription: Road-legal all-terrain crane for general lifting work.
mobile-crane-25t.description: A road-legal all-terrain mobile crane with 25 tonne capacity, suited to lifting and positioning across plant sites and confined yards. Supplied with a certified rigger-operator, full rigging gear and a current load chart.
features: Full rigging set: slings, shackles, spreader bar
Suited to confined and uneven terrain

crawler-crane-100t.name: Crawler Crane 100T
crawler-crane-100t.shortDescription: Tracked lattice-boom crane for heavy lifts.
crawler-crane-100t.description: High-capacity crawler crane with lattice boom for heavy lifts on industrial and infrastructure sites. Tracks suit soft and uneven ground; supplied with certified crew and full load documentation.

forklift-5t.name: Forklift 5T
forklift-5t.description: 5 tonne diesel forklift rated for rough terrain, ideal for yard and construction material handling. Heavy-duty tyres with high ground clearance.

excavator-20t.name: Excavator 20T
excavator-20t.shortDescription: 20 tonne hydraulic excavator with long reach.
excavator-20t.description: 20 tonne tracked excavator with long-reach arm for excavation, trenching and demolition. Fully serviced; certified operator available.

wheel-loader-3m3.name: Wheel Loader 3m³
wheel-loader-3m3.shortDescription: 3 m³ bucket wheel loader for loading and stockpiling.
wheel-loader-3m3.description: 3 m³ wheel loader with 4WD for loading, stockpiling and material handling on site. Productive and manoeuvrable for civil and plant work.

backhoe-loader.name: Backhoe Loader
backhoe-loader.description: Versatile backhoe loader with front loader and rear backhoe, 4WD and extendable dipper. Suitable for trenching, loading and general site work.

diesel-generator-100kva.name: Diesel Generator 100 kVA
diesel-generator-100kva.shortDescription: 100 kVA soundproofed diesel generator for site power.
diesel-generator-100kva.description: 100 kVA diesel generator in a soundproofed canopy for site power and standby applications. Fuel-efficient and ready for immediate deployment.

light-tower-led.name: LED Light Tower
light-tower-led.shortDescription: Mobile LED light tower for night works.
light-tower-led.description: Mobile LED light tower with mast-mounted fittings for night works and secure site illumination. Low fuel consumption and quiet operation.

air-compressor-185cfm.name: Air Compressor 185 CFM
air-compressor-185cfm.description: 185 CFM towable diesel air compressor for pneumatic tools, blasting and site air supply. Road-towable and ready for deployment.

well-point-system.name: Well-Point Dewatering System
well-point-system.shortDescription: Well-point system to keep excavations dry.
well-point-system.description: Well-point dewatering system engineered to lower groundwater and keep excavations dry and safe. Includes headers, pumps and discharge management.

submersible-trash-pump.name: Submersible Trash Pump
submersible-trash-pump.shortDescription: Submersible pump for trash and site water.
submersible-trash-pump.description: Heavy-duty submersible trash pump for removing site water, slurry and dewatering flows. Solids-handling impeller for dirty water applications.

tube-fitting-scaffold.name: Tube-and-Fitting Scaffold
tube-fitting-scaffold.description: Tube-and-fitting scaffold erected by certified riggers following TG20 practice. Flexible system for façades, structures and complex geometries.

scissor-lift-12m.name: Scissor Lift 12 m
scissor-lift-12m.shortDescription: 12 m electric scissor lift for work at height.
scissor-lift-12m.description: 12 m electric scissor lift for safe work at height indoors and on finished floors. Zero-emission, non-marking tyres and compact platform.

pickup-4x4.name: Pickup 4×4
pickup-4x4.shortDescription: 4×4 pickup for site supervision and crew transport.
pickup-4x4.description: 4×4 pickup (Toyota Hilux or equivalent) for site supervision, crew transport and off-road access on project sites. Driver included.

personnel-bus-30.name: Personnel Bus 30-Seat
personnel-bus-30.description: 30-seat personnel bus with air conditioning and safety belts for workforce transport to and from site. Comfortable and safety-compliant.

site-cabin-portacabin.name: Site Cabin (Portacabin)
site-cabin-portacabin.shortDescription: Portable site office and accommodation cabin.
site-cabin-portacabin.description: Portable site cabin/portacabin for site offices, welfare and worker accommodation. Insulated, wired and ready for rapid deployment.
